items.title: 资料来源：Decagon 提供人工智能客户服务代理，最新估值为 $4.5B，它聘请了一家银行，并正在与包括 ServiceNow 在内的买家进行早期谈判（Katie Roof/Business Insider） / Sources: Decagon, which offers AI customer service agents and was last valued at $4.5B, hired a bank and is in early talks with buyers, including ServiceNow (Katie Roof/Business Insider)
